page.overview:
Who is Amycus Carrow?

J.K. Rowling: Yes, because a Patronus is used against things that the Death Eaters generally generate, or fight alongside. They would not need Patronuses.”

Professor Amycus Carrow was a Dark wizard, brother of Alecto Carrow and a Death Eater. Amycus fought in the First Wizarding War along with his sister. They did not search for Lord Voldemort after his first downfall but were forgiven after Voldemort's return in 1995 and joined the Death Eater ranks in the Second Wizarding War.

After the fall of the Ministry of Magic in 1997, Amycus was made the Dark Arts professor, which replaced the previous subject of Defence Against the Dark Arts. His sister was stationed at Hogwarts as well, as the new Muggle Studies professor. He and his sister were also made Deputy Headmasters, serving under Headmaster Severus Snape. Together, the pair created an atmosphere of fear and cruelty towards those students they disliked, whilst allowing those whom they liked to enjoy special privileges.

In the evening of 1 May 1998, shortly before the Battle of Hogwarts, he was tortured by Harry Potter when he spat in Professor McGonagall's face. He was then Imperiused and tied up in Ravenclaw Tower by McGonagall herself. After the battle, he managed to escape custody with his sister, Corban Yaxley, and Walden Macnair and briefly attempted to free Dolores Umbridge and use a Time-Turner to bring back Voldemort's regime, but was recaptured and sent to Azkaban along with the others for their crimes.
